newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian index weighed down by Dadas and Finmedia.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian index weighed down by Dadas and Finmedia.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 0.86 percent on Tuesday, pulled down by a more than four percent fall in market heavyweights Dadas and Finmedia.

"Falls in these old shares is nothing to be worried about. We're more concerned about movements of newly privatised companies' shares -- which are still rising," said Danilo Grasic, an analyst at bank Creditanstalt.
Grasic said he expects shares of newly privatised firms to continue their upward trek due to feverish demand from investors.
* The seven-share SBI index fell 8.09 points to 933.68.
* Six shares fell and 12 rose, while six were untraded.
* Turnover climbed to 165.3 million tolars from 137.7 million.
* New shares of drug maker Lek were the most actively traded, firming 1.74 percent to 15,626 tolars on volume of 7,209 shares for total turnover of 112.7 million tolars.
* Financial consultancy Finmedia was the leading decliner, falling 6.85 percent to 15,700 tolars on volume of 14 shares for total turnover of 220,000 tolars.
* Financial consultancy Primofin was the biggest gainer, firming 8.41 percent to 17,150 tolars on volume of four shares for total turnover of 69,000 tolars.
* Financial consultancy Dadas fell 4.84 percent to 14,554 tolars on volume of 257 shares for total turnover of 3.7 million tolars.
